title: Petfolio Guardian
tagline: A DeFi platform that combines automated DCA trading with virtual pet care.
description:
Petfolio Guardian represents a paradigm shift in DeFi by making automated trading emotionally engaging and socially rewarding. It's not just another DCA platform - it's a complete ecosystem that combines the best of DeFi technology with gamification psychology to create sustainable, long-term trading behaviour.

The platform's unique approach addresses the fundamental challenge of user retention in DeFi while providing genuine financial value through sophisticated automated trading strategies. By making trading fun, social, and rewarding, Petfolio Guardian has the potential to bring DeFi to a much broader audience while helping users build wealth through consistent, emotion-free investment strategies.
how_its_made:
How It Works - The Complete Flow
1. Smart Contract Architecture 
The platform is built on a sophisticated smart contract system:
TwapDcaHook: A custom hook that implements 1inch's interface for time-weighted recurring fills
Permit2: Gas-efficient token approvals and transfers
Keeper Bots: Automated execution of DCA orders at specified intervals

2. DCA Strategy Implementation 
Users can set up various DCA strategies:
Regular DCA: Standard dollar-cost averaging with custom intervals
DCA Yield: Complex yield strategies with 13 different options
DCA to Friend: Social trading where you help others invest
Manual Swaps: One-time trades for immediate pet feeding

3. Pet Happiness System 
Your hippo's health (0-10 scale) is directly tied to trading activity:
DCA Yield: +3.0 health (highest reward)
DCA to Friend: +2.0 health (social bonus)
Regular DCA: +1.0 health (standard)
Manual Swap: +0.5 health (basic)
Decay: -0.5 health every 6 hours without activity

Technical Infrastructure
Frontend Architecture 
React + TypeScript: Modern, type-safe development
Tailwind CSS: Responsive, beautiful UI
Wagmi: Seamless wallet integration
React Query: Efficient API state management

API Integration 
The platform integrates with 1inch's complete API suite:
Quote API (v6.0): Real-time swap quotes and price estimates
Swap API (v6.0): Executable swap transactions
Token API (v1.3): Token metadata, logos, and lists
Balance API (v1.2): User token balances across networks
Price API (v1.1): Live token prices in USD
Gas Price API (v1.4): Current gas prices for optimisation
Approval APIs (v6.1): Token allowances and approvals
Limit Order SDK: Order creation and management

Data Layer 
Supabase: PostgreSQL database for user data, feeds, and health records
Real-time updates: Live portfolio tracking and health monitoring

Unique Value Propositions
1. Gamified Trading 
Unlike traditional DeFi platforms, Petfolio Guardian makes trading emotionally engaging. Users care about their hippo's happiness, which drives consistent trading behaviour.
2. Automated Excellence 
The keeper bot system ensures DCA strategies execute reliably without manual intervention, eliminating human error and emotional decisions.
3. Social Trading 
The "DCA to Friend" feature introduces a social element, allowing users to help others invest while earning health rewards.

Future Roadmap
Phase 2 Features 
Pet Evolution: Hippos can evolve based on trading performance
Community Features: Pet parks, trading competitions, leaderboards
Advanced Strategies: Options trading, yield farming integration
Mobile App: Native iOS/Android applications
Cross-chain Support: Expansion to Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism
